name: Apple M2 Max 64GB Llama-3.3-70B 4bit token-gen
methodology: Silicon Score Llama-3.3-70B model page row; M2 Max 38-core, 64 GB, 4-bit via LM Studio; ~400 GB/s unified.
notes: 64 GB config only fits a 70B Q4 at LOW context - capacity, not bandwidth, is the constraint here. Bandwidth-scaled from the same table: M1 Ultra (800 GB/s) 12.6 t/s, M3 Ultra (800) 15.5, M4 Max (546) 11.8 - M2 Max at 400 GB/s landing 8.8 is consistent with the bandwidth-limited decode model.
